explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/416: with V(x) the number of n ≤ x in the image of φ, 'Erdős [Er35b] proved V(x) = x(log x)^{−1+o(1)}'. The Lean variant: ∃ f = o(1) such that eventually V x = x·(log x)^{−1 + f x}, with V x = #{1 ≤ n ≤ ⌊x⌋ : ∃ m, φ(m) = n} over real x. Since V(x) > 0 for x ≥ 1, this existential equality is exactly the standard meaning of (log x)^{−1+o(1)}. Faithful.
